by: Relentless builder, delegated: naming (design/RimMandrake/delegation_policy.md; not a section 2 call)
rule: biome_mod_architecture.md s7 Q11a: the tier split is by NAME PROVENANCE. An invented name may live in RM_; only a genuine canon name, i.e. one TAKEN from canon, is IP. Q12: an invented-name creature still prefixed RSW_ moves to RM_ per biome, at its sitting, never in a sweep.

RM_FireHawk.why: Invented for the Pyrelands, not taken from canon; 'fire-hawk' is a plain English compound (and a real-world name for fire-spreading raptors) that also happens to name a minor Tenoo bird. Provenance is invented, so Q11a keeps it in RM_; the label stays.

RM_FireWasp.why: Invented heatproof swarm scavenger; 'fire wasp' is a generic English compound that matches a Legends-only insect page. Not taken from canon, so not IP under Q11a.

RM_Kirruk.why: The player-facing label is 'dewglider'; 'kirruk' is only the internal defName, coined with the Weeping Stones -rrik/-rrak/-llak name family (RM_Mirrik, RM_Burrak, RM_Vellak), independently of a Legends reptile of Ossus. Invented provenance, so Q11a allows it. A rename would touch ~270 references (art, flight flip-book, the owner's review-sheet decisions) to change a name no player reads.

RM_Peeper.why: 'peeper' is an ordinary English word (a creature with extra eyes) that also names Legends birds of Belsavis. Invented provenance; not IP under Q11a.

RSW_Screecher.why: 'screecher' is generic English; ours is a Biomes-team-port corvid with no canon basis, so its name is not IP. Its RSW_ prefix is the Q12 class (invented-name creature still in RSW_), which moves to RM_ per biome at that biome's sitting, never by a sweep; nothing to rename for the homonym. It was already cut from the Cauldron patch by the owner's sheet note 2026-10-09.

RSW_Basilisk.why: Already deleted from src/ by BIOMES_PORT_PRUNE_FORTY_TWO_HITCHHIKERS (owner card 2026-11-04, 'Drop 42'); selftest_biomes_port_prune_42.py holds it absent. Nothing left to decide.
